design_name: Stealth Director (script-first): coop_mod/stealth.scr owning a one-way QUIET->LOUD weapons machine on top of the live engine disguise parity
architecture:
PRINCIPLE: the engine already owns disguise truth (g_coopDisgParity per-frame maintenance, player.cpp:5482-5511, with the GetCurrentThreat()>0 veto; per-target script deference via aihandler.scr:1184 coop_stealthBlocksAggro). The script layer therefore owns exactly ONE thing the engine does not: WEAPONS-OVER-TIME. A new file, coop_mod/stealth.scr, is the single owner of that state; every other system is reached through hooks it installs or chokepoints that already exist.

STATE: level.coop_stealthState, values NIL (non-stealth map, every gate NIL-inert by positive-form tests), "quiet" (unarmed window), "loud" (armed forever). One-way quiet->loud. Disguise loss is NOT a director state: it stays with the engine (drawn weapon / level.alarm / attacker veto) plus the existing takeAllDisguises permanence wiring, which is exactly what makes expectation 6/7 (vanilla AI behavior) hold - the director never adds a second disguise authority.

DIRECTOR LABELS (coop_mod/stealth.scr):
- init: called by maps/m2l2a.scr::main (MP branch, replacing the cvar-gated block at :38-42). Sets the load-time trio level.coop_noWeapon=game.true, level.coop_startUnarmed=1, level.coop_forcePapersEquip=game.true, level.coop_stealthState="quiet", level.coop_stealthLoud=0. This trio is the ENTIRE lifecycle mechanism: every one of the eight weapon-grant sites already consults level.coop_noWeapon (itemhandler.scr:745 managePlayerInventory early-exit, :1594 spawnWeaponAssert, :1629 backfill, :1755 sidearm pick, dbno.scr:231 downed pistol, dbno.scr:728 revive chain, medkit.scr:376 self-revive, plus coop_armOnBlown itself), and the per-body disguise+papers re-establishment block sits ABOVE the early-exit (itemhandler.scr:710-742). The director adds NO per-lifecycle hooks because none are needed - that was R5's structural finding and it is reused verbatim.
- goLoud local.reason: idempotent single funnel (if level.coop_stealthState=="loud" end). Sets state, level.coop_stealthLoud=1, prints "^~^~^ST LOUD reason=<r>", restores protected scene actors (unprotectScene), then waitthread coop_mod/itemhandler.scr::coop_armOnBlown (which clears the trio BEFORE re-giving - bug-1607 ordering already inside it - then arms every coop_isActive==1 alive player and displaces papers). All later spawns arm through the untouched normal pipeline. goLoud does NOT call takeAllDisguises: a checker bust without an alarm keeps disguise machinery live, exactly like vanilla (kill the officer quietly and holstered players stay covered; the attacker veto already un-disguises everyone while a real fight is on).
- notifyLoud local.reason: one added tail line in takeAllDisguises (itemhandler.scr, next to :1162) threads this, so every existing disguise-gone path (alarm master alarm_system.scr:704 - file NOT edited, blast radius e1l4/m6l1c avoided - plus items.scr uniform removal and e1l4) synchronizes the director without new wiring. It just calls goLoud with the reason.
- retireGuard local.guard: the bug-1631 freeze fix. Replaces coop_paperPassAll's immediate type_disguise "none" (itemhandler.scr:1176-1181) with a deferred poll: every 0.25s test local.guard.thinkstate, and only when it is no longer the disguise thinkstate fire type_disguise "none"; hard timeout 5s (> the 3s ACCEPT anim); on timeout SKIP retirement entirely - safe, because the engine's ACCEPT already demoted the sentry to salute permanently, so retirement is an optimization, never a correctness requirement. NEVER swaps a think while the actor is inside THINKSTATE_DISGUISE.
- protectScene / unprotectScene: QUIET-window protection for one-way-breakable scenes. Scope deliberately minimal (master-plan prevention shape): the card trio $suckyfatty gets enableenemy 0 at init (their stand path is one-way by construction; the bug-1637 shim's retail manager handles seating, the director only removes the combat-transition eject vector). unprotectScene (called from goLoud AND from a one-line preamble in m2l2a.scr::cardplayersdeath before its attackplayer at :270) sets enableenemy 1 first - leash re-home is harmless since they are seated at their original origin. Scientists guy1-3, welders, workers are NOT protected: their anims recover via existing scienceinterupt/alarmthread machinery and guy1-3 must keep engine sight for the naxos-caught cansee checks.
- quietWatchdog (optional, marker-only by default): 1Hz while quiet, prints "^~^~^ST FLAP" if any holstered has_disguise player reads engine is_disguised==0 for >1s (means an actor with real threat is attacking - e.g. the unreachable engine bump-latch fired). Detection surface for playtest; can later be promoted to a goLoud trigger after observation.

LOUD TRIGGERS (all funnel to goLoud, each with its reason string):
1. Checker detection (expectation 4): a coop preamble line in anim/disguise_enemy.scr and anim/disguise_halt.scr - if(level.coop_stealthState=="quiet"){ thread coop_mod/stealth.scr::goLoud "checker" }. These anim scripts are executed BY the engine disguise thinks at the exact moment any sentry/officer resolves hostile (officer Fake_Papers show/12s timeout, sentry 12s timeout, walk-away HALT), so this is the officer-alerts-as-normal hook with zero engine change. NIL-inert on every other disguise map (positive-form test on a map-scoped level var).
2. Alarm (expectation 5): alarm master -> takeAllDisguises (existing, unedited) -> notifyLoud tail -> goLoud "alarm". Disguises additionally go permanently (existing takeAllDisguises semantics preserved).
3. Naxos caught-in-the-act: maps/m2l2a.scr::coop_naxosCaught (:489) rewired to thread goLoud "naxos_caught" (replacing the dead setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro 0 + direct coop_armOnBlown); the local scientist bust ohnothenaxos1 still runs - vanilla-local, disguise machinery survives if players deal with it, matching retail.
4. Damage while quiet: coop_blownOnDamage (:571) rewired to goLoud "damage" (keeps its german-attacker-within-1600u filter); its dead setcvar line removed.
5. Undisguised-player sighting: waitForEnemy (:882) already fires attackplayer at engine-undisguised players only; add thread goLoud "seen_armed" beside its ^~^~^ STEALTH print at :913.
6. Officer waves: officer.scr::coop_officer_wait_goloud poll (:118) gains one clause "|| level.coop_stealthLoud == 1" so the deferred m2l2a wave layer wakes on ANY loud, not only a rung alarm (flagged as a tunable decision; removing the clause reverts to alarm-only waves).

SCENE/AGGRO HYGIENE DURING QUIET (extending the shipped bug-1639 per-target pattern, never a cvar window):
- aimaneuver.scr (~:149, before runto+forceactivate): skip any candidate whose enemy is a player with is_disguised==1 - closes the R4 open item where a zero-threat tracking guard could be yanked mid-interrogation.
- aihandler.scr coop_spawnReplica: while level.coop_stealthState=="quiet", skip cloning entirely (scene actors must not duplicate mid-scene); post-loud backups/reinforcements clone normally.
- aihandler.scr coop_apply_personality: gate the 12% prone-pose roll (whose stand-up exit fires attackentity) behind level.coop_stealthState != "quiet".
- aihandler.scr disguiseHandler :1021: switch the spotting test from the mod flag !coop_isDisguised to the engine is_disguised getter - the last non-parity reader, closing the R4 desync window.
- aisquad/morale/replica-targeting gates: already engine-parity (bug-1639), untouched.

WHAT SCRIPT CANNOT REACH, AND HOW THE DESIGN AVOIDS NEEDING IT:
1. m_bForceAttackPlayer (one-way, ctor-cleared): script cannot clear it. Avoided by never latching a disguised player anywhere (all mod sites gated; the retail m2l2a bust labels fire only in contexts where going loud is intended). Residual: the engine bump-branch (disguised player physically blocking a pathing actor) latches un-suppressibly - mitigated by goLoud-on-damage arriving at the first hit, surfaced by the FLAP watchdog marker; accepted and documented rather than fought.
2. type_disguise swap inside THINKSTATE_DISGUISE freezes forever: unavoidable engine fact; retireGuard's thinkstate-poll deferral guarantees the swap never happens in-state, and the timeout path forgoes retirement rather than risk it.
3. is_disguised is an EV_GETTER: never chased with writers; the director asserts only has_disguise (managePlayerInventory block, giveDisguiseOnSpawn) and holster state, letting the engine compute per frame.
4. The challenge sight-trace hardcoded to G_GetEntity(0)->centroid (actor.cpp:8994, E1 unimplemented): script cannot retarget it. The design tolerates it: papers gates are TEAM-GLOBAL (level.papers is level-wide; a sentry ACCEPT runs the accept-thread that disarms the punish-trigger nets for everyone and demotes the checker), so only ONE player - in practice the always-present listen-server host - needs to be challenge-eligible per gate. TP-4 (host-hidden client challenge) is a documented expected-fail, not a dependency.
5. FlagBadEnemy / enemy-set wipes are not script-exposed: no grace-period mechanic is offered or needed; loud is one-way by user requirement.
6. The engine spawn-frame DM rifle and world weapon pickups are un-gateable: the former dies to managePlayerInventory's takeall 1-2 frames later; the latter is contained by the existing coop_stealthStripWeapons sweep at the uniform scene (a 4-pass class drain, never takeall) and becomes moot once loud.
per_expectation: E1 unarmed across ALL lifecycle events: stealth.scr::init sets the level-scoped trio (coop_noWeapon/coop_startUnarmed/coop_forcePapersEquip) at MAP LOAD, the R5-blessed pattern. Every body funnels through managePlayerInventory (itemhandler.scr:695): takeall then coop_noWeapon early-exit (:745) blocks the grant, while the disguise+papers block ABOVE it (:710-742) re-establishes has_disguise + papers on that body. Death respawn, spectate return, late join, reconnect: level flags survive entity destruction, so every new body inherits the window automatically (player self.flags do not matter). DBNO: dbno_enter:231 skips the downed pistol, dbno.scr:728/medkit.scr:376 skip revive re-gives, keyitems.scr coop_key_guardian re-gives papers post-revive. Picking up disguise or papers (L1 or L2) grants InventoryItems only - the engine rule (player.cpp:5480, InventoryItem in hand keeps disguise) means the player stays unarmed AND covered. Zero new per-lifecycle hooks: the choke point already covers all six transitions.

E2 one uniform pickup arms the whole team with it: existing items.scr uniform pickup -> giveUniformToAll + giveDisguiseToAll (changeGameType-0 has_disguise latch per player) and papers -> givePapersFlagToAll (itemhandler.scr:2530) - unchanged. Late joiners inherit via level.coop_enableDisguises/coop_uniformOnSpawn/coop_itemPapers read in the managePlayerInventory stealth block, which runs for every join. The director never touches this path; it only guarantees the window flags do not interfere (they do not - the block is above the early-exit, the bug-1624 lesson already applied).

E3 FIRE shows papers, everywhere, without breaking checks: coop_papersAnytime (itemhandler.scr:1207, primary-fire while unarmed raises papers any time) + enableClickablePapers (interrogation-window click, threaded per check from anim/disguise_papers.scr) + forcePapersInHand (main.scr:1015 per spawn under coop_forcePapersEquip) - all live, all NIL+NULL guarded per bug-1603. The engine handshake is already per-player-correct (papers item fire anim stamps the OWNER's m_ShowPapersTime, checker compares vs its Begin snapshot). The one thing that could break later checks - coop_paperPassAll freezing the accepting guard (bug-1631) - is fixed by stealth.scr::retireGuard's deferred type_disguise swap, so goatsbutt and sentry2dude survive their ACCEPT and every other guard on the map keeps checking normally.

E4 officer/wrong-papers detection goes LOUD: the engine officer think (Fake_Papers: papers shown OR 12s -> ENEMY; walk-away -> HALT) executes anim/disguise_enemy.scr / disguise_halt.scr at exactly that moment; a one-line stealth-gated preamble in each threads stealth.scr::goLoud "checker". goLoud waitthreads coop_armOnBlown, which clears the trio FIRST then gives every active player their loadout and raises a weapon. Because the trio is cleared, every subsequent lifecycle event (death, dbno, respawn, spectate, reconnect, join) flows through the now-unblocked normal loadout pipeline and spawns armed - permanence comes free from the one-way flag clear.

E5 any alarm goes LOUD identically: alarm master (alarm_system.scr:704, file untouched) already calls takeAllDisguises; a single added tail line in takeAllDisguises (itemhandler.scr ~:1162) threads stealth.scr::notifyLoud -> goLoud "alarm". Weapons arm as in E4; the alarm additionally voids disguises permanently via the existing takeAllDisguises semantics, which stay exactly as shipped.

E6 all AI play vanilla scripts and anims: the director adds NO forced behavior to any actor. Protection is subtractive and quiet-scoped: card trio enableenemy 0 (removes the only one-way eject vector; retail bug-1637-shimmed manager still runs the whole card-hand loop), replica cloning suppressed while quiet (no mid-scene duplicates), prone personality roll gated off while quiet, aimaneuver skips actors tracking a disguised player. All retail m2l2a scene labels (Norway pair, scientists, welders, sledgehammer, crane/cometolife, officer1 walk, whattheydoin, norgirls, intercom) remain verbatim; aisquad/morale stand-downs already suppress forceactivate. unprotectScene restores enableenemy before any scripted attackplayer (cardplayersdeath preamble + goLoud).

E7 loud equals vanilla cover-blown behavior: goLoud only arms players - it adds no script disguise-voiding, no scripted aggro, no wave forcing beyond the optional officer-poll clause. Post-loud detection is 100% engine: drawn weapons blow is_disguised per frame (parity), NoticeShot/squad-share/threat pipeline propagate as retail, the alarm race (ai_gofor_alarm to the switch) and zone backups run untouched, and checker ENEMY/HALT escalate to ATTACK on the engine's own timers. Where the alarm rings, the existing takeAllDisguises permanence applies (a recorded deviation from vanilla's recoverable alarm, kept deliberately - flagged as a user decision, not changed here).

PRESERVED: coop_naxosSabotage hold-USE quiet path, its caught-in-the-act cansee checks on guy1-3, ohnothenaxos1's local bust, objective adds + coop_objToastStart + both toast calls - all kept; the only edits inside them are replacing the two dead setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro lines with goLoud calls.

ASCII/CRLF, depthscan2-verified; threads receive numbers/strings only, players resolved via replace.scr::player_closestTo pattern (bug-1632 discipline).

autoexec.cfg (:1171-1176): remove the HZM-baseline revert block forcing coop_stealthStart/coop_stealthNoAggro to 0; seed coop_stealthStart 1 (coop_stealthNoAggro is dead wiring post-1639 and is dropped entirely).

NO CHANGES to: global/alarm_system.scr (reached via the itemhandler tail - avoids the e1l4/m6l1c blast radius), global/cardgame.scr (bug-1637 shim already live), openmohaa-hzm engine (parity + veto stay as-is; E1 sight-trace retarget explicitly NOT taken), dbno.scr/medkit.scr/player.scr/main.scr (their coop_noWeapon gates and stealth block already do the work).
loud_state_machine: STATES: NIL (non-stealth map; every director gate uses positive-form tests so the whole system is inert), QUIET (level.coop_stealthState=\"quiet\": trio set at map load, all eight grant sites blocked, players unarmed+disguised, card trio enableenemy 0, cloning/prone-roll/maneuver-on-trackers suppressed), LOUD (\"loud\": trio cleared atomically by coop_armOnBlown, all actives armed, every future body arms via the untouched normal pipeline, scene protections lifted). TRANSITION: exactly one, QUIET->LOUD, through the idempotent funnel stealth.scr::goLoud(reason); no path back. TRIGGERS (reason strings, each printed as ^~^~^ST LOUD reason=<r> for the harness): \"checker\" (anim/disguise_enemy.scr + disguise_halt.scr preambles - officer Fake_Papers show/timeout, sentry 12s timeout, walk-away HALT), \"alarm\" via notifyLoud (takeAllDisguises tail, fed by alarm master / uniform removal / e1l4), \"naxos_caught\" (guy1-3 cansee during the hold-USE sabotage), \"damage\" (coop_blownOnDamage poll: HP drop with attacking german within 1600u), \"seen_armed\" (waitForEnemy: a player drew a weapon in view of the Norway pair). DISGUISE is deliberately NOT a director axis: the engine computes it per frame (holster/InventoryItem=covered, draw=blown, alarm=void, attacker-with-threat=veto), and permanence-on-alarm remains the existing takeAllDisguises wiring - so a local bust (naxos scientists, a single blown checker) arms the team but leaves stealth mechanically recoverable exactly as retail intends, while an alarm ends it for good. ORTHOGONAL GUARD LIFECYCLE: retireGuard defers coop_paperPassAll's type_disguise \"none\" until guard.thinkstate has left the disguise think (0.25s poll, 5s timeout, timeout=skip since engine ACCEPT already demoted him to salute) - the freeze arm is structurally unreachable. MARKERS: ST LOUD, ST RETIRE ok/skip, ST FLAP (watchdog: holstered has_disguise player reading is_disguised==0 for >1s while quiet = engine bump-latch or limbo attacker; observation-only until playtested). ACCEPTANCE: TP-1b keystone (post-naxos quiet continuation to a sentry2dude L2 accept) must pass with state still QUIET; TP-4 host-hidden client challenge remains a documented expected-fail (entity-0 sight trace, out of script reach).
why_ledger_safe: Every recorded failure class is addressed by construction, not re-proposed. Strip-vs-grant (1604/1606/1607/1624): the director adds ZERO takeall calls and ZERO strip-based logic - it owns only the load-time trio (the e1l3 block-future-grants semantics) and disarms exclusively through coop_armOnBlown, which already clears flags before re-giving; per-body work stays in the existing block above managePlayerInventory's early-exit, so nothing sits below it (the exact 1624 mistake). Invented-disguise-definitions (1617/1603): the director never defines \"disguised\" - it reads the engine getter everywhere, and the only writers it touches (has_disguise via existing helpers) follow the engine InventoryItem rule; all unarmed-hand tests inherit the NIL-and-NULL double guard. Aggro (1615/1616/1618/1639): no new attackplayer site is introduced; the three new gates (aimaneuver, clone suppression, prone roll) EXTEND the shipped per-target engine-flag pattern with no cvar window and no pre-gate state stamping; the alarm's structurally-separate path is joined via the takeAllDisguises tail, not wrapped. Freeze (1631): the fix is the recorded direction (defer until the disguise think exits) and its failed_attempts are not revisited - no sit-loop heuristics, no thinkstate-guessing eject logic; card protection is prevention (enableEnemy 0) layered on the now-live 1637 shim, evaluated before anything further, per the master plan's agreed shape. Thread/entity discipline (1632/1624): stealth.scr passes numbers and strings across thread boundaries, never entities, and resolves players via the player_closestTo recipe. Dead wiring flagged in R4/R6 (coop_stealthArmOnHurt, the two setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro lifts) is removed, not built upon. Shared-file blast radius: alarm_system.scr and cardgame.scr are untouched; the two edited anim/disguise_*.scr preambles are NIL-inert on e1l4 and every other disguise map. Superseded-plan hygiene: the design is built on the parity model (1638/1639), not the frozen-latch model the v1 plan assumed, and it takes NO new engine change - the E1 trace retarget is explicitly declined with its consequence (host-relative challenge initiation) documented as an accepted limitation rather than silently depended on. Process: new/edited .scr files follow T1/T2 (ASCII, CRLF, depthscan2, no bare negatives), all state transitions emit ^~^~^ST markers for the recorded TP-1..TP-6 harness, and no engine deploy is required, eliminating the 1633/1634/1635 wrong-binary verdict class for this feature entirely.
risks: Engine bump-latch is un-suppressible from script: a disguised player body-blocking a pathing actor permanently disguise-blinds that actor and confirms client 0; mitigation is goLoud-on-damage at the first hit plus the ST FLAP watchdog marker - between bump and first shot, players are briefly unarmed under fire. If playtest shows this biting, the watchdog can be promoted to a goLoud trigger with one line.

checker-HALT firing goLoud may feel harsh for a player who merely strays >256u mid-papers-check (engine HALT->1.5s->ATTACK is coming regardless, so arming is correct, but the pacing needs playtest); tunable by dropping the disguise_halt.scr preamble and relying on the damage trigger.

The entire parity stack under the design (1638 maintenance, 1631 veto, 1639 gates, 1637 cardgame shim) is PENDING PLAYTEST; TP-1b is the keystone acceptance run and any failure there re-opens the engine-vs-script split.
Officer wave wake-on-loud (level.coop_stealthLoud clause) changes mod combat pacing vs alarm-only; flagged as a user decision, one line to revert.

enableenemy 0 on the card trio deafens them to curious sounds during quiet (vanilla-visible only if a player expects them to react to nearby noise before any bust); restored at goLoud and before cardplayersdeath's attackplayer.
coop_armOnBlown arms DBNO players (coop_isActive==1 and alive at 100hp) with empty hands until revive re-give - known R5 edge, accepted; verify in the 2P TP-3 run.

Host-relative challenge initiation (entity-0 sight trace) remains: clients 2-4 only get papers-checked when the host's chest is traceable; mitigated by team-global papers gates but visible in 4P play; fixing it requires the declined E1 engine change.

takeAllDisguises permanence on alarm is retained (user expectation 5 reads as one-way), but vanilla's recoverable-alarm is now technically restorable under parity - recorded as an open user decision, not silently changed.
